description: Get cached company news for one exact Bullrun ticker, newest publication first, with publisher, source URL, publication date and stored-fetch freshness when recorded. Optional since cutoff and limit up to 50; only the newest 50 stored articles are searched. Useful for company headlines and article sources; use get_corporate_calendar for scheduled earnings/dividends and get_earnings_call_transcript for call text. Reading news also registers demand and requests a best-effort background cache refresh; this response does not wait for or confirm a refresh. Cached/empty/stale results do not establish that no new events exist. Does not change portfolios or place trades. Successful results include an optional platformLink for continuing this research or reviewing the exact saved draft in Bullrun. When useful, present its descriptive link and respect its description of any settings not carried over.

limit.description: Maximum returned articles, newest publication first. Up to 50 cached source articles are read before cutoff filtering.

since.description: Inclusive publication-time cutoff. YYYY-MM-DD means midnight UTC; timestamps need an explicit Z or UTC offset. Applied to the newest 50 stored articles, not a full historical news archive.

ticker.description: Exact native Bullrun company ticker, e.g. AAPL, SAP or ABBN. Resolve the symbol with search_stocks first if uncertain.

name: get_company_news
title: Get company news with sources and freshness
